entries.name: feclearexcept

tms6747.why: RTS6x keeps no floating-point environment, as <fenv.h> says for this target: the C6000 ABI's helpers, which divide and convert, round to nearest and raise no exceptions (SPRAB89B 8.1), so the chip's rounding modes and flags (FADCR, FAUCR, FMCR) cannot speak for a program's arithmetic, and sim6747 and vm6747 model neither
